title: Android Developer
description:
Job Summary 
 Android Developer with 1 - 2 years of hands-on experience building and maintaining Android applications. You will work closely with our product, design, backend, and engineering teams to build reliable, polished, and scalable mobile experiences. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving problems, cares about code quality, and wants to take ownership of features from development through release. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Build and maintain Android applications using Kotlin. Develop new features based on product and design requirements. Work with REST APIs and integrate backend services into the mobile application. Build clean, reusable, and maintainable UI components. Debug issues, investigate crashes, and improve application stability and performance. Write unit and integration tests where appropriate. Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving engineering practices. Work closely with backend engineers to define and integrate APIs. Collaborate with product and design teams to turn requirements into high-quality mobile experiences. Help diagnose and resolve issues reported from QA and production. Stay up to date with modern Android development practices and libraries. 
 
 Requirements 
 12 years of professional Android development experience. Good knowledge of Kotlin. Good understanding of the Android SDK and Android application lifecycle. Experience building Android applications using Android Studio. Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, HTTP, and authentication. Familiarity with Jetpack components, particularly ViewModel, LiveData/StateFlow, Navigation, and Room. Good understanding of Git and standard software development workflows. Ability to troubleshoot, debug, and solve problems independently. Good understanding of object-oriented programming and basic software design principles. 
 
 Nice to Have 
 Experience with Flutter and Dart. Experience with Jetpack Compose. Experience with Firebase, including Crashlytics and Analytics. Experience with push notifications and deep linking. Experience writing automated tests. Understanding of Android performance optimization. Experience publishing applications through the Google Play Console. Familiarity with CI/CD for Android applications. Experience working with third-party SDKs and payment integrations. Experience using AI-powered coding and agentic programming tools, such as Anthropic Claude, in day-to-day development.
